name: seahorse_halo
description: a deep zoom in crisp, saturated multicolour escape bands: a hot yellow and orange halo in the far field, magenta flames and a dark navy lace band nearer the set, blue and cyan clusters ringed by cream and gold at its heart

reference.made_with: an escape-time deep zoom of the Mandelbrot set, unsigned, 2560x1600

reuses: field smooth through the map by rank at one and a half cycles: the far field takes the map's hot yellow and orange start (the halo), the bands nearer the set its magenta, navy, blue and cyan, and the set's own fringe comes round to the map's royal blue (rank 1 at one and a half cycles lands at map position 0.5), the cream and gold falling mid-frame
glow_filaments' falloff glow on de, painted near-black plum and multiplied at half opacity: the dark hair that keeps the lace crisp
the tone pass, at the reference's median and p10
notes: Added: nothing: the smooth count through a cyclic map by rank at 1.5 cycles, a dark `de` hair, the tone pass

Lessons: The thirteenth and fourteenth styles came in one item, from two crisp deep zooms that are close to plain escape time: `seahorse_halo` (saturated blue clusters ringed by gold, orange and magenta inside a hot yellow-orange halo) and `citadel` (gold, cream, mauve, plum and umber). The item allowed either to land as a palette alone if a matched map under a named mode caught it; **neither did**, and both are the same three-layer stack with no new primitive: the smooth count through a cyclic matched map **by rank**, a dark falloff hair on `de`, and the tone pass. Three lessons. **What a named mode lacks here is the rank spend, not a layer**: `smooth` with the matched map read far off the reference at every probe seat (`seahorse_halo`'s washed into one yellow, median up to 0.19 over and p10 up to 0.43 over; `citadel_gold`'s a dark maroon, median 0.17–0.24 against 0.45), while the same map by rank spreads the bands over the frame's samples and holds the balance at all 40 scout drafts of each. **The cycle count is the reference's order**: at one cycle `seahorse_halo` runs halo, magenta, navy, blue, cream once and gives the set's whole fringe the map's lime end, which the tone pass turns olive; at one and a half the fringe comes round to the blue, the reference's heart. `citadel`'s regions alternate warm and dark across the frame, which two cycles draws. **A cream stop held wide floods a far field**: the first `citadel` map's cream spanned a fifth of the map and read white 0.056–0.096 against 0.034; held to a narrow stop between pale gold and mauve it reads 0.02–0.07 at full size. Lights did not help either: one ring a step corrugates every band, and a slope-only gloss barely shows, so both are picker rows. The library already held a map named `citadel` (a pooled-library conversion, a washed brown, p90 ~0.63 against 0.81 in this stack), so the matched map is `citadel_gold`. Locations are an ordinary scout of the parameter plane.
